notes: Survivorship-bias warning: this is a present-day snapshot of XU030 membership, not a point-in-time-accurate reconstruction of the index as it stood on 2026-07-01; secondary web sources do not reliably archive past composition, so this list should not be used to infer historical constituent status without independent confirmation.

Secondary-source status: KAP disclosures are not accessible in this environment; this list is cross-checked across two web sources (infoyatirim.com and getmidas.com) that returned an identical 30-symbol set, rather than official KAP data.

A third source, uzmanpara.milliyet.com.tr/canli-borsa/bist-30-hisseleri, disagreed on 3 of 30 tickers (it listed CIMSA, HEKTS, ULKER where infoyatirim/getmidas list DSTKF, GUBRF, VAKBN). This is resolved in favor of the infoyatirim/getmidas set: a user-supplied Borsa Istanbul periodic-change document (see the 2026-10-01_2026-12-31 file's 'derivation' field) shows DSTKF being removed from XU030 effective 2026-10-01, which is only consistent with DSTKF having been a current (2026-07-01..09-30) constituent -- confirming infoyatirim/getmidas and indicating the milliyet set was stale for this period.

infoyatirim.com and getmidas.com returned byte-for-byte identical 30-symbol sets and appear to share an underlying market-data feed; they are treated here as corroborating but not fully statistically independent sources.
